turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Nimbus Broadband support. Am I speaking with the account holder?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes. And listen, this is the third time this month. I pay for 200 Mbps and get nothing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm really sorry. Could you give me the last four digits of your registered mobile?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I can see two earlier complaints on your account. What's happening right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It drops every ten minutes. I work from home. I lost a client call today because of this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's really frustrating. Are any lights red or orange on the router?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, all green. It just drops.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Honestly, after three complaints you deserve better. I'm going to refund your full bill for this month and upgrade you to our 300 Mbps plan free for three months.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, it's done from my side. You'll see it on your next bill.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: A technician will check that too. You'll get an SMS.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Soon. Is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your patience. Have a good day.
